name: Minerva
source:
A rough, silver-haired female general who is said to be the best warrior in Thracia. She is feared by her subordinates for her extremely strict character, both towards herself and others.

She clashes with Voldo whenever she meets him, as she is psychologically incompatible with Voldo, who prefers the sneaky way of doing things, where results mean everything.

She is the daughter of a prominent family that is on the verge of collapse, and is eager to rebuild her family name. She is the wife of Ares. She promises her husband that they will have children when they return.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/ingoku/]Official site[/url]]
